text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambian press on Tuesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Four local government officials have been arrested for stoning to death an impala in a zoo and stealing the carcass.
- Former president Kennth Kaunda's United National Independence Party (UNIP) is too broke to meet its wage bill and debt obligations.
- The government has said it will evacuate all diplomatic staff in Zaire because of the worsening civil war, but gave no further details.
- The president's office said it will not allow illegal vendors in Lusaka's city centre to be harrassed by local authorities.
- State House says it will continue using former foreign minister Vernon Mwaanga as a presidential envoy despite him being a self-confessed drug trafficker.
